defaults.remedy_main_checkout: work in a worktree (EnterWorktree, then the postenter script of the worktree-kit plugin), land the change on the default branch through a pull request, then fast-forward this checkout with `git pull --ff-only`. On the main checkout itself, `git pull --ff-only` and `git merge --ff-only` pass.
defaults.remedy_default_branch: move the default branch only through a merged pull request: push YOUR branch (force is fine there), open the pull request, rebase it, merge it, then fast-forward the main checkout.
